sources.entry: SolidInvoice - Open source invoicing and quote application. (Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: SolidInvoice is an open-source, self-hostable invoicing and quoting platform for freelancers and small businesses, built on Symfony and PHP.
summary.what_it_does: It lets you create quotes that convert into invoices, set up recurring invoices, and send payment reminders and overdue notifications on a schedule. Clients and contacts are managed with custom fields and per-client currency, and multi-tenancy allows several companies in one install. Invoices support multi-currency amounts, multiple flat or percentage taxes, per-line discounts, and 8 built-in PDF templates. Payments work through bring-your-own gateways (Stripe, PayPal and others) via Payum, with payment links sent alongside invoices. The app also offers a REST API (API Platform 4) with token auth, a built-in MCP server, Meilisearch search, grid and full company data export, and 2FA, Google OAuth and role-based access control.
use_cases: send quotes and invoices to clients
track overdue invoices and payment reminders
manage multiple companies from one install
how_to_run: git clone the repository, then: cd SolidInvoice && composer install
notable: Official Docker image and a single self-contained binary (also via Homebrew), so no PHP install is needed for the binary route
Built-in MCP server with OAuth2 for AI agent automation
Multi-tenancy with Doctrine filters, ULID primary keys and encrypted secrets
Helm charts for Kubernetes and opt-in Prometheus metrics
Same codebase for self-hosted (MIT) and hosted versions
caveats: Self-hosted installs are maintained by you: updates and backups are manual
A paid hosted tier ($8/month) exists; hosted version removes SolidInvoice branding and adds early access
From-source setup requires PHP 8.4+ with several extensions and a MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL database
